content.short: LeverUp is an LP-free perpetuals exchange on Monad with uncapped open interest.
content.description: LeverUp runs perpetuals without a liquidity provider pool backing trades, which removes the cap on open interest that pool-based designs impose and avoids passing trader profits through to LPs as losses. It redistributes fees rather than retaining them. The trade-off in LP-free designs is that the mechanism balancing longs against shorts has to work without a counterparty of last resort.
